panels.description: Finalized immutable 1-minute UTC OHLCV bars from marts.final_bars (replay clock anchored; unaffected by wall-clock $__timeFilter).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bar_end AS time, open::double precision AS open, high::double precision AS high, low::double precision AS low, close::double precision AS close, volume::double precision AS volume FROM marts.final_bars WHERE ticker = '${ticker}' AND ('${run_id}' = '' OR run_id = '${run_id}') ORDER BY bar_end ASC LIMIT 240

panels.title: Finalized 1m Bars (Replay / Business Clock UTC)

panels.description: Separates signaled accuracy, signal coverage (excluding NO_SIGNAL abstention), realized/pending/expired counts from marts.realized_outcomes_v.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN outcome_status = 'realized' AND signal_label IN ('UP','NOT_UP') THEN (was_correct::int * 100.0) END)::numeric, 2), 0)::double precision AS signaled_accuracy_pct, COALESCE(ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signal_label IN ('UP','NOT_UP')) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 2), 0)::double precision AS coverage_pct, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome_status = 'realized') AS realized_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome_status = 'pending') AS pending_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome_status = 'expired') AS expired_count FROM marts.realized_outcomes_v WHERE ('${ticker}' = '' OR ticker = '${ticker}') AND ('${run_id}' = '' OR run_id = '${run_id}')

panels.title: Label Coverage, Signaled Accuracy & Outcome Counts

panels.description: Top native attribution factors (model score space, not causal/calibrated delta) from marts.model_predictions.shap_factors.

targets.rawSql: WITH recent AS (SELECT shap_factors FROM marts.model_predictions WHERE ticker = '${ticker}' AND ('${run_id}' = '' OR run_id = '${run_id}') ORDER BY bar_end DESC LIMIT 50), exploded AS (SELECT jsonb_array_elements(shap_factors) AS factor FROM recent) SELECT factor->>'feature' AS feature, AVG((factor->>'shap_value')::double precision) AS avg_contribution FROM exploded GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY ABS(AVG((factor->>'shap_value')::double precision)) DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: Native Score Top Contributing Factors (Last 50 Predictions)

panels.description: Single-worker lease status, predictions written, expired backlog, and wall-clock cycle compute duration (ms).

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_id, dataset_id, status, predictions_written, expired_backlog_count, COALESCE(ROUND(last_compute_duration_ms::numeric, 2), 0)::double precision AS last_compute_duration_ms, last_prepared_bar_end, last_predicted_bar_end, updated_at FROM marts.prediction_worker_state ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Worker State, Backlog & Wall-Clock Compute Duration (ms)

panels.description: Ingestion delivery progress per Kafka topic/partition: committed offsets, processed vs quarantined count, and partition status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rdp.run_id, ir.mode, ir.provenance, rdp.topic, rdp.kafka_partition, rdp.last_kafka_offset, rdp.processed_count, rdp.quarantined_count, rdp.status, ir.logical_as_of, rdp.updated_at FROM raw.run_delivery_progress rdp LEFT JOIN raw.ingestion_runs ir ON ir.run_id = rdp.run_id ORDER BY rdp.updated_at DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Kafka Partition Delivery & Replay Clock Provenance

panels.description: Ingestion latency for real_live events (ingested_at - available_at) vs quarantined malformed events. Replay paused/closed never counts as live outage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw.ingestion_quarantine) AS total_quarantined, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingested_at - available_at))), 0.0) FROM raw.market_bars WHERE provenance = 'real_live') AS real_live_max_ingestion_latency_s, (SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(available_at))), 0.0) FROM raw.market_bars WHERE provenance = 'real_live') AS real_live_source_freshness_s, (SELECT COALESCE(AVG(compute_duration_ms), 0.0) FROM marts.model_predictions) AS avg_prediction_compute_ms

panels.title: Latency, Quarantine & Real-Live Freshness (Isolated from Replay)
